name: Custom Code
description: Adds your own code to the head or body of every page: analytics, a verification tag, a chat widget or a font. Choose which pages get it. No theme edits needed.

panels.title: Custom code
panels.description: Code added to the published pages of this site, exactly as you paste it. Only paste code from people you trust: it runs for every visitor. Changes apply to a page the next time it is published.

fields.name: enabled
fields.title: Add the code to pages
fields.description: Turn this off to leave every page exactly as it was rendered, without losing your code.

fields.name: head
fields.title: In the head
fields.description: For analytics, verification meta tags, fonts and stylesheets. Placed just before </head>.

fields.name: body-start
fields.title: At the start of the body
fields.description: For code a service asks to place "right after <body>", such as a tag manager's noscript part.

fields.name: body-end
fields.title: At the end of the body
fields.description: For chat widgets and scripts that should load after the page. Placed just before </body>.

choices.title: Every page except those listed below

fields.name: page-list
fields.title: Page list
fields.description: Page addresses separated by commas, for example: home, contact, blog/*. A * at the end means every page under it.
